subject: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check

Team —

Quick heads-up as we push into the last two weeks of the quarter: finance asked for a clean stage pass so CP/Q3 numbers are accurate for forecasting. Please do the following by COB Wednesday (21 Jun):

- Update stage for any opportunity that has a verbal commit to "Commit" and add the committed ARR and expected close date.
- If a deal is still at Champion / Evaluation with no firm pricing, move it to "Best Case" and set the probability accordingly.
- Flag any deals that require procurement/legal engagement so we can coordinate DocuSign/follow-up.

I attached the EMEA_weekly_stage_template.xlsx — use it if you want to batch uploads. Note the definition of "Commit" below: 1) verbal approval from economic buyer, 2) PO/intent to sign within 30 days OR active procurement started with timeline.

I'll pull a rollup mid-day Wednesday and send to finance. If you're blocked on data from the customer (pricing/PO), please call it out in your reply rather than leaving it blank.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, EMEA Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check

Thanks Sean — I will update the top five EMEA deals and upload the sheet by EOD Tuesday. Quick question on Telco EU (RWD-EMEA-4521): they gave a verbal OK last week but legal asked for a custom data retention clause. Do we treat that as "Commit" or hold as "Best Case" until legal OKs?

I'll attach my working csv for transparency.

Attachment: vanessa_updates.csv (csv, 12KB)

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 13:22:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check

Vanessa — per our definition, a verbal OK from the economic buyer + active legal redline is still enough to mark as "Commit" provided procurement has started and there is a named PO owner. For Telco EU I have a note from last Thursday that procurement opened a request and Peter Adams is the PO contact. Move to Commit and set expected close to 2027-07-10, but add "legal dependency" in notes so Finance can see the risk.

Also: I'm moving two APAC deals to Commit (APAC-CloudCo and SakaTech) — will push final values to the template tonight.

Attachment: karthik_commit_notes.pdf (pdf, 35KB)

Karthik Iyer
Sales Lead, APAC
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@telco-eu.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple notes from finance ops:

- If sales marks Telco EU as Commit, please confirm the expected billing start (month) and whether the customer prefers monthly vs annual invoicing. DocuSign will be initiated only after we receive legal signoff on the retention clause.
- For APAC moves, confirm currency (USD vs local). Finance will normalize to USD in the weekly rollup.

I'll need the completed template by 11:00 UTC Wednesday to include in the official forecast. If anyone is relying on procurement to produce a PO, please loop in the PO contact now (e.g., Peter at Telco EU).

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2027 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: Stage clarity rollcall: EMEA/APAC forecast check — midweek snapshot

Team —

Quick rollup from the updates so far (I'll paste into the finance sheet):
- Telco EU (RWD-EMEA-4521): Vanessa -> Commit, expected close 2027-07-10, legal dependency noted; PO contact Peter Adams (peter.adams@telco-eu.com).
- APAC-CloudCo: Karthik -> Commit, $420k ARR, close 2027-06-30, currency USD.
- SakaTech: Karthik -> Commit, $95k ARR, vendor contract pending, close 2027-07-15.

Next steps: Vanessa/Karthik update the template by 11:00 UTC; Laura will consolidate and confirm numbers with Finance Ops. I've also added the HubSpot link and the drive folder for any manual uploads.

Related links: https://hubspot.com/deal/RWD-EMEA-4521, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-EMEA-forecast

If anyone anticipates slippage past July, mark the new expected close in the sheet so we avoid overstating the quarter.

Thanks — Sean
